lines.text: Many learners say: I see TV every night.
Better: I watch TV every night.
Watch! I watch TV after dinner.

native.tip: TV는 see가 아니라 watch! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I watch TV every night.”
native.caption: “I see TV every night”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 TV를 볼 때는 see 대신 watch를 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I watch TV every night.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “watch”! TV는 watch! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: For TV, say watch, not see. “I watch TV every night”!
en.caption: Do you say “I see TV every night” in English? 😅 We use “watch” for things that move on a screen. “I watch TV every night” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
